data.name: Matthew
data.gender_notes: Matthew is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Mattityahu, 'gift of Yahweh'. Its root is Hebrew m-t-t-y-h. Matthew the Apostle; the Gospel of Matthew. Matthew is a Hebrew name meaning “Gift of God”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Matthew expresses “Gift of God”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Hebrew Mattityahu, 'gift of Yahweh'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Matthew total 27, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
